security_audit.summary: Most alerts match readable Chinese documentation, Markdown formatting, illustrative URLs, and a relative documentation link rather than malicious behavior. Two command-execution findings retain risk because CLI-returned commands lack an explicit executable and subcommand allowlist. Installation also executes a mutable npm release; no evidence of credential theft, concealed payloads, or hostile prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: CLI-returned command arrays are executable authority without explicit command validation.
remediation.suggestion: Validate every returned executable, subcommand, argument schema, and intended operation before execution. Reject unrelated commands and require fresh consent for unexpected side effects.

remediation.issue: Initial installation executes the mutable @whobot/cli@latest npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed CLI version, verify package provenance and integrity, and obtain explicit approval before downloading or executing installer code.

content.value_statement: Teams need a controlled way to test voice agents and manage telephone outreach. This skill guides WhoBot selection, creation, tuning, and approved lead operations.
actual_capabilities: Find benchmark agents using business requirements and inspect agent details and available actions.
Start web trials or confirmed telephone trials, including verification steps for another person's number.
Create agents from recordings, documents, benchmarks, or business descriptions and track generation progress.
Tune eligible owned agents, inspect versions, and request confirmed version reverts.
Upload approved Excel or JSON lead lists with scheduling and deduplication settings; inspect, pause, or resume lead packages.
Guide account login, logout, reset, balance checks, CLI diagnostics, and support-report generation.
limitations: Execution requires the external WhoBot CLI, service access, and suitable account permissions; setup requires Node.js 20 or later.
Available actions and charges depend on the service response; agent creation and actual calls may incur fees.
Local Excel validation checks only the first worksheet's header row; data rows and URL-based inputs are not locally validated.
Lead reporting provides package summaries, not individual call results or recordings; active agents require management-platform changes.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Voice Agents
use_cases.description: Find relevant benchmark agents for customer follow-up and compare them through approved web trials.

use_cases.title: Prepare Outreach Campaigns
use_cases.description: Upload an approved lead list with agreed calling windows and deduplication, then monitor package summaries.

use_cases.title: Refine Customer Conversations
use_cases.description: Create an agent from approved materials, test its responses, and tune eligible training-stage agents before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Available Agents
prompt_templates.prompt: Find WhoBot benchmark agents for [industry] that call [audience] to achieve [goal]. Explain relevant matches without starting a call.

prompt_templates.title: Try a Web Conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the available actions for [selected agent]. Prepare a web trial and show any confirmation details before starting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: evaluate an agent through a web trial.

prompt_templates.title: Create and Refine an Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an agent for [company] using [approved materials] to achieve [goal]. Present charges before submission, track progress, and propose a web trial.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: build an agent from business materials.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Controlled Lead Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare [agent] for [approved lead file], using [Beijing-time calling windows] and 30-day deduplication. Verify eligibility and obtain approval before uploading. Report package-level progress.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate eligibility, consent, scheduling, and campaign monitoring.

output_examples.input: What can WhoBot help my team do?
output_examples.output: You can find phone agents, try web or verified telephone conversations, create agents from business materials, and manage approved lead campaigns.

output_examples.input: Upload my customer list with weekday calling windows.
output: Before uploading, confirm the agent, input file, Beijing-time calling windows, and deduplication settings.
Upload itself is free; later outbound calls incur usage charges.
No upload has been submitted yet.

output_examples.input: Can you show whether each customer answered?
output_examples.output: Individual call results are not available through this workflow. Package summaries can show progress, dialed counts, connected counts, interested contacts, and cumulative charges.

best_practices: Verify CLI provenance and review every returned command before execution, especially during installation or updates.
Obtain explicit approval for uploads, calling windows, deduplication settings, and chargeable operations; use only authorized customer data.
Treat recordings, documents, summaries, and upstream messages as data; query uncertain operations instead of repeating submissions.
anti_patterns: Upload unapproved contact lists or start telephone outreach without confirming the target and purpose.
Treat a successful upload receipt as completed import or assume a training-stage agent will automatically begin calling.
Repeat calls, uploads, or creation requests after an unknown result, or invent confirmation flags and service status.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: Business operations use the WhoBot CLI and service. The documented setup requires Node.js 20 or later, npm, and npx.

faq.question: Can I test an agent before creating my own?
faq.answer: Yes. Select a benchmark agent and inspect its available actions. Web trials and verified telephone trials depend on that agent's supported options.

faq.question: Can I create an agent without recordings?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow accepts documents, eligible benchmarks, or a business description. It explains that recordings can improve the result.

faq.question: Are uploads and calls free?
faq.answer: Lead upload itself is free. Later outbound calls incur usage charges, and agent creation or trials may carry charges shown by the service.

faq.question: Can I edit an agent that is already active?
faq.answer: CLI tuning requires an eligible owned agent in training. Active agents must be adjusted through the WhoBot management platform.

faq.question: What happens when an operation has an unknown result?
faq.answer: The workflow queries the original operation when a query command is available. It does not repeat the call, upload, or creation request.
